problems.quote: Anthropic introduced Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 on Monday.
problems.explanation: The claims name the model 'Claude Fable' with no version number. Only Mythos is given as 5.2, so 'Claude Fable 5.2' is not supported. The headline has the same problem.

problems.quote: Anthropic introduced Claude Fable and Mythos five point two on Monday.
problems.explanation: The claims only report Anthropic saying the two are the same underlying model with different access. Nothing says Anthropic introduced or launched them, or that they are new (the hook also calls them 'new').
